messages:
sam: Quick random Q — if you could permanently borrow one skill/talent from anyone (real or fictional), what would you pick?
jen: Teleportation. commute solved. :raised_hands: 
dara: My grandmother's ability to remember everyone's birthday and exactly what to say. superpower for parties.
michael: Speed-reading + actual retention. imagine finishing papers in an hour and remembering them. :nerd_face: 
ash: Parkour. urban navigation level: unlocked. also a great icebreaker at parties.
kai: Absolute pitch. always wanted to tell people their singing is off-key with confidence. :sunglasses: 
jen: also, invisibility would be tempting for annoying meetings but ethics??? :thinking_face: 
sam: @jen haha same ethics question. stealth would be useful for sneaking snacks into the all-hands.
ops-bot: Reminder: do not use teleportation or invisibility to bypass access controls. :robot_face: 
michael: @ops-bot rules aside, I'd still pick memory + focus combo. deadlines would become chill.
dara: Ooh, learning languages instantly would be amazing. travel + awkward smalltalk solved.
ash: vote: 1) teleport 2) memory 3) instant languages 4) parkour 5) absolute pitch. react with :one: thru :five: to vote.
sam: I'll take memory. been losing keys too often. :disappointed_relieved: 
jen: voted :three: (languages)
kai: :five:
michael: :two:
dara: :two: as well
ash: tally so far — memory: 2 (sam + michael), languages: 2 (jen + dara), parkour: 1 (nash), pitch: 1 (kai)
sam: tie-breaker idea — one wild combo allowed? like teleportation + speed-reading? :eyes: 
jen: too OP. house rules: only one skill.
ash: final thought — if it's fictional, can I take 'wizardry' and then only do harmless magic like perfectly toasted bagels? :bagel:
kai: that is a very specific wizard class but yes.
ops-bot: Incidentally, if anyone actually acquires teleportation please notify Security for a quick risk assessment. :shield:
michael: Noted. thanks ops-bot.
dara: great thread, love these randoms. new office icebreaker next week? I can bring bagels.
sam: bagels and borrowed talents — perfect. thread closed (until someone invents an ethically sourced way to borrow skills). :laughing:
